propositions: transport.py repeatedly hits the 800-line cap, blocking new parent-related changes and forcing reactive rescue splits that do not address root cause
Previous splits (retry.py, transitions.py) were facade-only relocations that left transport.py as the sole perceived home for new operations, restarting growth cycles

Capability Protocols defined in _backend.py (_TicketTransport_, _SupportsLinks_, _SupportsComments_, _SupportsAbsenceProbe_) are the natural module boundaries and are not currently used to organize code

Reorganizing transport.py into single-class mixin-based composition (five modules per capability, all 100–500 LOC) will make the home for each future operation deterministic without changing behavior or Protocol conformance
Relocation must preserve all passing tests unedit, avoid reintroducing the duplication that commit 9bb9 fixed (_resolve_epic_link_field_id), and land before further parent work
